pages.title: Auxiliary Generator
pages.text: Thermal Bank is an additional power-generating device. When burning Minecraft fuels (such as coal or charcoal), it consistently generates 150 $(efu) of power; when burning batteries from this mod, it generates varying amounts of power that are significantly higher than those produced by burning regular fuels. $(br2)Base power output: 150 $(efu)$(br)Footprint: 2x2

pages.title: Usage
pages.text: When the power grid is experiencing a shortage, you can add a Thermal Bank to increase total power generation. Thermal Bank can be placed anywhere and connected to the power grid. $(br2) Multiple Thermal Banks can be used in combination, and their power generation capacities add up directly.
Check the exact recipe in the Crafter. Required materials can be looked up in REI/JEI.
